scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I recently submitted a housing loan application and I wanted to check on the status. Can you tell me if my application was approved or denied?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application was approved and the loan was originated.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! What is my interest rate and the total cost of the loan? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 6.375%. The total costs associated with the loan are $3,291.34. The loan product type is a Conventional:First Lien.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage and it does not have any negative amortization features. The loan has not been sold to another institution.

dialogue.user: Got it. One last thing, what is my debt-to-income ratio and how does it affect my application? Can you explain what that means for me?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is between 30% and 36%. This ratio compares your monthly debt payments to your monthly income. A lower ratio may indicate less risk to lenders, but the specific impact on your application is not detailed in the record.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for all the information. It's been very helpful.

<Very Satisfied> The agent was polite, knowledgeable, and provided all the details I needed to understand my loan status and terms. I feel confident about the information I received.
